The previous sidebar was written as a skeleton/shopping list, as a temporary one. I was meaning to rewrite it, but before I did that, I thought I'd ask how subscribers think it should be written. I'm going to write down a slightly detailed description of the purpose and attitudes I wanted to have this subverse for, and then I'd like it people could help me put it in brief so it doesn't take much space, but also using the right words so people don't misunderstand.

(I did have a few paragraph here, but I determine they were useless information. Here's my description of the purpose of this subverse from another thread. I tried writing it differently, but I couldn't get it to work as well as this.)

This subverse..or at least I, who made it, is not against individuals. It's not about hating anyone. That defeats the point. My wording in the sidebar is, yes, not very good. It's incomplete is what it is. What this subverse is against isn't the people, it's their behaviour. I believe that subverses designed to hate or mock others will only come to a poor end. SRS was supposedly ironic at the start, but now look. TiA, no matter how much they protest, is cruel and judgemental.

That's why I want this subverse to oppose their attitudes. Hate won't solve anything. Who has ever been helped by knowing a thousand people loathe them and think they're scum? Who was ever motivated by having pictures taken of them on the sly and being shamed behind their back?

The idea is instead of hating, be compassionate. Be kind. I've never known anyone who was more motivated by shame or pain than by the encouragement of others. Even the people in those hateful subverses should not themselves be hated; again, what would that solve? I feel bad for them, I don't hate them. That would defeat the point of this subverse. Choosing to keep on making themselves angry when they can't do anything about it..What can you do about it? It's not your life. I spent a long time being angry about things I couldn't control. I wouldn't suggest it.

Please help me summarise this appropriately for the sidebar.

"Negativity is everywhere and is the go-to response to any conflict . This is a place to communicate without vitriol towards each other and encourage others to do so by example." Then add a heart on the end cuz it's compassion and hearts are compassionate or something. ❤
